title.zh: 不等式 · 天平倾斜，答案是一整段
title.en: Inequalities · A Tilted Scale Has a Whole Range of Answers

description.zh: 一元一次不等式的解集是数轴上的一段；两边加减不变号，乘除负数要翻号。仅限 a·x+b<c（或≤）。
description.en: The solution of a linear inequality is a stretch of the number line; adding or subtracting keeps the sign, multiplying or dividing by a negative flips it. Only a·x + b < c (or ≤).

reason.zh: 乘负数使数轴上的次序颠倒，与一次函数中斜率为负时直线向下倾斜是同一回事。
reason.en: Multiplying by a negative reverses order on the number line, the same fact as a negative slope making a line fall.

title.zh: 解不等式为什么乘负数要变号？
title.en: Why does multiplying by a negative flip the inequality?

ask.zh: 不等式两边同时加一个数，不等号方向变吗？同时乘一个正数呢？
ask.en: Add the same number to both sides of an inequality — does the sign change? What about multiplying both sides by a positive number?

ask.zh: 把不等式想成一条直线：乘负数相当于把直线怎样翻转？翻转后，原来大的那边跑到哪边去了？
ask.en: Think of the inequality as a line — what does multiplying by a negative do to that line? After the flip, where does the side that was bigger end up?

reveal.zh: 加减和乘正数都不改变大小关系；乘负数相当于把数轴翻转，原来大的一边翻到了小的一边，所以不等号必须变向。
reveal.en: Adding, subtracting and multiplying by a positive keep the order; multiplying by a negative flips the number line, so the side that was bigger lands on the smaller side — the sign must flip.
